lines.en: I solved that mystery before you did.
You are UFC legend Chuck Liddell.
To me, Sherlock Holmes is literally the greatest character in the Western canon.
Replace his pasty British frailty with superhuman physical fitness and you get...
Hey, where's my lovely daughter tonight?
I knew that you would be here, and I was worried that you might be concerned seeing us together at night.
You're a very thoughtful guy, but really, I have no problem with the two of you dating.
Really, I mean, look at you. You're just, you know, beautiful.
Oh, on the inside, where your spirit lives.
Listen, tell her, come to the party, and I don't mind at all.
Look, you can text without looking at your phone?
I think it's rude not to maintain eye contact with people that I'm talking to.
